description: The plot titled “BBQ” illustrates how accuracy varies with the number of demonstrations for several methods. The x-axis is labeled “#Demonstrations,” uses a linear scale, and spans roughly from 0 to 1500 with labeled ticks at about 250, 500, 750, 1000, 1250, and 1500. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy,” uses a linear scale, and shows labeled ticks at approximately 45, 50, and 55 (units not specified). A dark navy solid line with circular markers (labeled “Squared Exponential”) starts near about 54 accuracy at the leftmost point and rises to around 58–59 by the right side, with a noticeable early increase and then a gentler upward slope. A medium-blue solid line with circular markers (labeled “Tanh”) begins around 49 and increases gradually to about 56 by the highest demonstration count. A light lavender/blue solid line with circular markers (labeled “ELU”) begins around 47–48 and increases steadily to roughly 54–55 at the rightmost point. A pink dash-dot line (labeled “LLaMA-2-chat-7B”) appears as a baseline, rising slightly from about 44–45 on the left to around 47–48 near the right edge.
